an5.44:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Vesāliyaṃ viharati Mahāvane Kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ. Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Uggassa gahapatino Vesālikassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. Atha kho Uggo gahapati Vesāliko yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Uggo gahapati Vesāliko Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
an5.44:2.1: Sammukhā me taṃ bhante Bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ ‘manāpadāyī labhate manāpan' ti. Manāpaṃ me bhante sālapupphakaṃ khādaniyaṃ, taṃ me Bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā ti. Paṭiggahesi Bhagavā anukampaṃ upādāya.
an5.44:3.1: Sammukhā me taṃ bhante Bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ ‘manāpadāyī labhate manāpan' ti. Manāpaṃ me bhante sampannakolakaṃ sūkaramaṃsaṃ, taṃ me Bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā ti. Paṭiggahesi Bhagavā anukampaṃ upādāya.
an5.44:4.1: Sammukhā me taṃ bhante Bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ ‘manāpadāyi labhate manāpan' ti. Manāpaṃ me bhante nibbaddhatelakaṃ nāliyāsākaṃ, taṃ me Bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā ti. Paṭiggahesi Bhagavā anukampaṃ upādāya.
an5.44:5.1: Sammukhā me taṃ bhante Bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ ‘manāpadāyī labhate manāpan' ti. Manāpo me bhante sālīnaṃ odano vigatakāḷako anekasūpo anekavyañjano, taṃ me Bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā ti. Paṭiggahesi Bhagavā anukampaṃ upādāya.
an5.44:6.1: Sammukhā me taṃ bhante Bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ ‘manāpadāyī labhate manāpan' ti. Manāpāni me bhante kāsikāni vatthāni, tāni me Bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā ti. Paṭiggahesi Bhagavā anukampaṃ upādāya.
an5.44:7.1: Sammukhā me taṃ bhante Bhagavato sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ ‘manāpadāyī labhate manāpan' ti. Manāpo me bhante pallaṅko gonakatthato paṭikatthato paṭalikatthato kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sa-uttaracchado ubhato lohitakūpadhāno. Api ca bhante mayam p'etaṃ jānāma ‘n'etaṃ Bhagavato kappatī' ti, idaṃ me bhante candanaphalakaṃ agghati adhikasatasahassaṃ, taṃ me Bhagavā paṭiggaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyā ti. Paṭiggahesi Bhagavā anukampaṃ upādāya. Atha kho Bhagavā Uggaṃ gahapatiṃ Vesālikaṃ iminā anumodanīyena anumodi.
an5.44:8.1: Manāpadāyī labhate manāpaṃ yo ujubhūtesu dadāti chandasā acchādanaṃ sayanam ath' annapānaṃ nānappakārāni ca paccayāni,
an5.44:9.1: cattañ ca muttañ ca anuggahītaṃ khettūpame arahante viditvā so duccajaṃ sappuriso cajitvā manāpadāyī labhate manāpan ti.
an5.44:10.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Uggaṃ gahapatiṃ Vesālikaṃ iminā anumodanīyena anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
an5.44:11.1: Atha kho Uggo gahapati Vesāliko aparena samayena kālam akāsi, kālakato ca Uggo gahapati Vesāliko aññataraṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ upapajji. Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. Atha kho Uggo devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho Uggaṃ devaputtaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:-- Kacci te Ugga yathādhippāyo ti? Taggha me Bhagavā yathādhippāyo ti. Atha kho Bhagavā Uggaṃ devaputtaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:
an5.44:12.1: Manāpadāyī labhate manāpaṃ, aggassa dātā labhate pun' aggaṃ, varassa dātā varalābhī hoti, seṭṭhaṃ dado seṭṭham upeti ṭhānaṃ.
an5.44:13.1: Aggadāyī varadāyī seṭṭhadāyī ca yo naro dīghāyu yasavā hoti yattha yatthupapajjatī ti.
